translated: Also, when I'm reading, I often look for Western music or BGM that fits the story.
The other day, I was reading a book set in the Mayan civilization...
You really read all sorts of books, don't you?
At the time, I searched for free music that sounded like the Mayan civilization, and things actually came up.
Listening to that really gets me into the mood.
I get it, I get it.
If it's an action story, I'll pick something intense...
And if it's set by the sea, then I'll listen to...
Do you have specific books you like to bring on trips?
Oh, when I travel, I try to bring books I've already started. I usually read several books at the same time.
My mood changes, so I might feel like reading one thing one day and something else the next.
Since the genres are all over the place, I really want to narrow it down when I travel, right?
Because I want to pack light.
But if I start reading and realize I'm not in the mood for that specific book, I regret it so much.
